column6: eval (() => {   const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6'));   const results = [];   for (const h of headings) {     const text = h.textContent;     if (text.includes('404')) {       results.push({ id: h.id, text: text.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ') });     }   }   return results; })()

eval (() => {   const h = document.getElementById('name-404-not-found');   if (!h) return 'not found';   // Let's get the text of its parent element or sibling elements   const parent = h.parentElement;   return {     headerText: h.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '),     parentText: parent ? parent.textContent.substring(0, 500).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ') : ''   }; })()
